input: Source a refurbished espresso machine under budget

gold.taskTitle: Source a Refurbished Espresso Machine Under Budget
gold.taskDescription: Find and purchase a refurbished espresso machine that fits within a set budget.

questions.title: What is your exact budget limit in your currency?
questions.description: Establish the precise maximum amount the user is willing to spend.

questions.title: What espresso machine brand or model do you prefer?
questions.description: Identify whether the user has a specific brand, model, or feature set in mind.

questions.title: Is this machine for home or commercial use?
questions.description: Determine the intended environment and usage intensity of the machine.

questions.title: How many espresso shots will you pull daily?
questions.description: Understand the volume of use to ensure the machine's capacity matches needs.

questions.title: Do you need a built-in grinder or standalone machine?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants an espresso machine with an integrated grinder.

questions.title: Which sellers or platforms are you open to buying from?
questions.description: Find out if the user has preferred or trusted sources such as manufacturer refurb programs, eBay, or local stores.

questions.title: What is your deadline for having the machine ready?
questions.description: Determine if there is a time constraint that affects sourcing and shipping decisions.
